mapper.sql: SELECT e.tenant_id,e.session_id,r.target_kind,r.target_id,r.agent_id,r.end_user_id,r.input_id,r.root_input_id,r.trace_id,r.span_id,r.caused_by_event_id, e.run_id,NULL::text AS execution_id,e.canonical_json::jsonb->>'actionId' AS action_id,NULL::text AS delegation_id, e.event_id,NULL::text AS event_fingerprint,e.type AS event_type,NULL::text AS event_version,e.schema_id AS payload_schema_id, e.canonical_json AS payload_canonical_json,e.event_sequence AS session_sequence,e.revision, e.occurred_second AS occurred_at_epoch_second,e.occurred_nano AS occurred_at_nano FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_events e JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs r ON r.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND r.run_id=e.run_id
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, tenant_name, session_id, user_id, user_name, target_type, agent_id, agent_name, team_id, team_name, channel_id, channel_type, channel_name, answer_status, execution_status, summary_text, message_count, root_input_count, active_execution_id, expired_at, first_message_at, last_message_at, latest_root_input_id, event_upper_bound, message_upper_bound, created_at, updated_at, last_activity_at, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_count FROM candidates ORDER BY last_activity_at DESC, tenant_id, session_id

SELECT tenant_id, tenant_name, session_id, user_id, user_name, target_type, agent_id, agent_name, team_id, team_name, channel_id, channel_type, channel_name, answer_status, execution_status, summary_text, message_count, root_input_count, active_execution_id, expired_at, first_message_at, last_message_at, latest_root_input_id, event_upper_bound, message_upper_bound, created_at, updated_at, last_activity_at, 1::bigint AS total_count FROM candidates

WITH base AS ( SELECT s.session_id, s.summary_text, s.updated_at, s.end_user_id, u.display_name AS user_name, s.agent_id, a.name AS agent_name, s.team_id, COALESCE(team.definition ->> 'name', team.id::text) AS team_name, s.channel_id, c.channel_type, c.name AS channel_name, t.name AS tenant_name FROM public.nw_chat_sessions s JOIN public.nw_tenants t ON t.id=s.tenant_id JOIN public.nw_end_users u ON u.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND u.id=s.end_user_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_agents a ON a.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND a.id=s.agent_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_agent_teams team ON team.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND team.id=s.team_id LEFT JOIN public.nw_channels c ON c.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND c.id=s.channel_id WHERE (#{scopeTenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR s.tenant_id=#{scopeTenantId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND (#{q,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR s.session_id ILIKE '%'||#{q}||'%' OR s.summary_text ILIKE '%'||#{q}||'%' OR u.display_name ILIKE '%'||#{q}||'%' OR a.name ILIKE '%'||#{q}||'%' OR c.name ILIKE '%'||#{q}||'%') ), session_options AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (session_id) 'session' AS kind, session_id AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(summary_text,''), session_id) AS label, tenant_name AS description FROM base ORDER BY session_id, updated_at DESC LIMIT 100 ), user_options AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (end_user_id) 'user' AS kind, end_user_id::text AS value, user_name AS label, tenant_name AS description FROM base WHERE end_user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_user_id, updated_at DESC LIMIT 100 ), agent_options AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (agent_id) 'agent' AS kind, agent_id::text AS value, agent_name AS label, tenant_name AS description FROM base WHERE agent_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY agent_id, updated_at DESC LIMIT 100 ), team_options AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (team_id) 'team' AS kind, team_id::text AS value, team_name AS label, tenant_name AS description FROM base WHERE team_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY team_id, updated_at DESC LIMIT 100 ), channel_options AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (channel_id) 'channel' AS kind, channel_id::text AS value, COALESCE(NULLIF(channel_name,''), channel_type) AS label, tenant_name AS description FROM base WHERE channel_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY channel_id, updated_at DESC LIMIT 100 ) SELECT * FROM session_options UNION ALL SELECT * FROM user_options UNION ALL SELECT * FROM agent_options UNION ALL SELECT * FROM team_options UNION ALL SELECT * FROM channel_options

WITH roots AS ( SELECT root_input_id, MIN(session_sequence) AS first_sequence, MAX(session_sequence) AS last_sequence, MIN(to_timestamp(occurred_at_epoch_second + occurred_at_nano / 1000000000.0)) AS started_at, MAX(to_timestamp(occurred_at_epoch_second + occurred_at_nano / 1000000000.0)) AS updated_at FROM () event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND session_sequence<=#{upperBound} GROUP BY root_input_id ), numbered_roots AS ( SELECT root_input_id, first_sequence, last_sequence, started_at, updated_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY first_sequence) AS round_number FROM roots ) SELECT root_input_id, round_number, first_sequence, last_sequence, started_at, updated_at FROM numbered_roots WHERE (#{beforeSequence,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR first_sequence < #{beforeSequence,jdbcType=BIGINT}) AND (#{targetRootInputId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR first_sequence <= (SELECT first_sequence FROM roots WHERE root_input_id=#{targetRootInputId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})) ORDER BY first_sequence DESC LIMIT #{limit}

WITH run_roots AS ( SELECT event.run_id, event.root_input_id, MIN(event.session_sequence) AS first_sequence FROM () event WHERE event.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event.session_id=#{sessionId} AND event.root_input_id IN #{item} AND event.run_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY event.run_id, event.root_input_id ) SELECT run.run_id, root.root_input_id, CASE WHEN run.phase='UNCERTAIN' THEN 'OUTCOME_UNKNOWN' ELSE run.status END AS status, run.created_second AS created_epoch_second, run.created_nano, run.updated_second AS updated_epoch_second, run.updated_nano FROM run_roots root JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_runs run ON run.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND run.session_id=#{sessionId} AND run.run_id=root.run_id ORDER BY root.first_sequence, run.run_id

SELECT 'ACTION_REQUEST' AS source_kind,a.run_id,a.request_ref AS operation_key,model.action_id AS loop_id, (SELECT count(*)::integer FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_actions prior WHERE prior.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND prior.run_id=a.run_id AND prior.kind='MODEL' AND prior.action_ordinal<=model.action_ordinal) AS iteration,a.action_id FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_actions a JOIN LATERAL(SELECT m.action_id,m.action_ordinal FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_actions m WHERE m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.run_id=a.run_id AND m.kind='MODEL' AND m.action_ordinal<=a.action_ordinal ORDER BY m.action_ordinal DESC LIMIT 1) model ON true WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.run_id IN #{item}

SELECT event.tenant_id,event.session_id,event.target_kind,event.target_id,event.end_user_id,event.run_id, event.session_sequence AS event_sequence,event.revision,event.event_id,event.event_type AS type, event.payload_schema_id AS schema_id,event.payload_canonical_json AS canonical_json, event.occurred_at_epoch_second AS occurred_second,event.occurred_at_nano AS occurred_nano FROM () event WHERE ORDER BY event.tenant_id,event.session_id,event.session_sequence
SELECT MAX(id) FROM public.nw_chat_messages WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId}
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM () event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND session_id=#{sessionId} AND root_input_id=#{rootInputId,jdbcType=VARCHAR})

SELECT event.session_sequence, event.input_id, event.root_input_id, event.run_id, event.execution_id, event.action_id, event.event_id, event.event_type, event.trace_id, event.caused_by_event_id, event.payload_schema_id, event.payload_canonical_json AS payload_canonical_json, event.occurred_at_epoch_second, event.occurred_at_nano, action.kind AS action_call_kind, parent.event_id AS parent_node_id FROM () event LEFT JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_actions action ON action.tenant_id=event.tenant_id AND action.action_id=event.action_id LEFT JOIN () parent ON parent.tenant_id=event.tenant_id AND parent.session_id=event.session_id AND parent.root_input_id=event.root_input_id AND parent.event_id=event.caused_by_event_id WHERE event.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event.session_id=#{sessionId} AND event.root_input_id=#{rootInputId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND event.session_sequence>#{afterSequence} AND event.session_sequence<=#{upperBound} ORDER BY event.session_sequence LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT event.session_sequence, event.root_input_id, event.run_id, event.action_id, event.event_id, event.payload_canonical_json AS payload_canonical_json, event.occurred_at_epoch_second, event.occurred_at_nano FROM () event WHERE event.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND event.session_id=#{sessionId} AND event.root_input_id IN #{item} AND (#{sequenceUpperBound,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR event.session_sequence<=#{sequenceUpperBound,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ORDER BY event.session_sequence

SELECT attempt.attempt_ledger_id, attempt.attempt_id, attempt.invocation_id, attempt.trace_node_id, attempt.run_id, attempt.session_id AS source_session_id, attempt.root_input_id AS source_root_input_id, COALESCE(usage.provider, attempt.provider) AS provider, COALESCE(usage.model, attempt.model) AS model, COALESCE(usage.call_point, attempt.call_point) AS call_point, CASE WHEN usage.prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL OR usage.completion_tokens IS NOT NULL OR attempt.prompt_tokens IS NOT NULL OR attempt.completion_tokens IS NOT NULL THEN 'PROVIDER_REPORTED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS usage_source, COALESCE(usage.prompt_tokens,attempt.prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens, COALESCE(usage.completion_tokens,attempt.completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens, usage.cached_input_tokens, usage.cache_write_input_tokens, usage.reasoning_output_tokens, usage.ingested_at, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.agent_runtime_execution_attempts actual JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_actions action ON action.tenant_id=actual.tenant_id AND action.run_id=actual.run_id AND action.action_id=actual.action_id AND action.kind='MODEL' JOIN public.agent_runtime_execution_materials request ON request.tenant_id=actual.tenant_id AND request.reference=actual.request_ref AND request.schema_id IN (#{modelRequestSchema},#{modelManifestSchema}) WHERE actual.tenant_id=CAST(attempt.tenant_id AS text) AND actual.run_id=attempt.run_id AND actual.attempt_id=attempt.attempt_id) AS diagnostic_available FROM public.observation_session_model_attempts attempt LEFT JOIN public.observation_effective_model_usage usage ON usage.tenant_id=attempt.tenant_id AND usage.attempt_id=attempt.attempt_id AND usage.session_id=attempt.session_id AND usage.run_id=attempt.run_id AND usage.root_input_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM attempt.root_input_id WHERE attempt.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND attempt.session_id=#{sessionId} AND (#{rootInputId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR attempt.root_input_id=#{rootInputId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AND (#{attemptUpperBound,jdbcType=BIGINT} IS NULL OR attempt.attempt_ledger_id<=#{attemptUpperBound,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ORDER BY attempt.attempt_ledger_id, attempt.attempt_id, usage.ingested_at
